name: Substrate (self)
description: This system: a hyperdimensional VSA memory + a typed-atom knowledge graph + a sound type-checker/prover; stores knowledge as checkable atoms and reasons over them.

name: Associative memory mechanism
description: Role-filler pairs are bound and superposed into one hypervector, then recovered by unbind + cleanup; verified functional (5/5 superposed-pair recall at N=1024).

name: Binding operator family
description: Operators that compose role-filler pairs into a single vector (FHRR elementwise mul / HRR circular convolution).

name: Cleanup / attractor-memory family
description: Operators that denoise a vector to the nearest stored codebook entry (attractor dynamics).

name: First-order optimizer family
description: Operators that update a parameter vector along a gradient; candidate shared supertype (abstraction-ratio target).

name: Spectral / codebook-geometry family
description: Operators that analyze codebook matrix structure (eigen/spectral geometry, similarity).

name: Sound prover / verifier
description: Type-checker + backward-chaining prover: verifies typed derivations against checkable ground truth and refuses what it cannot prove.

metadata.note: CHTV verifier + L6-PROOF; small-n soundness verified

name: Knowledge promotion operator
description: Promotes recurring T3 record atoms toward T1 foundational concepts via frequency, geometry, and structural-equivalence signals.

metadata.note: KP P1/P3/P4; signals select near-disjoint candidate sets

name: Capability: store
description: Encode a fact/structure as a typed atom (+ relations) in the substrate.

name: Capability: retrieve
description: Recover stored content by cue via binding/cleanup or partition-routed nearest-neighbor.

name: Capability: reason about self
description: Traverse the self-model graph + run the prover over it to prove operator relations, find redundancy, and surface gaps. THE goal capability; currently partial.

metadata.blocker: operator types not yet atomized; self-model not yet fully connected
